design: continuous predictor (log SD of 30-yr monthly temperature at isolation site); phylogenetic yes (phylolm, Pagel lambda~0.94); 1680 0.5-deg sites
note: Reference point for the comparisons below. One genome per species.

design: categorical/successional, community-weighted dormancy-gene trait; phylogenetic no
note: Community-level, not genome-level. Dormancy genes decrease over succession; TA/Rpf/spo queried in reconstructed metagenomes. Genome-level rrnDB check (H=1326.6) had no reported n.

design: categorical (host vs environment); sporulation from predictive gene set; phylogenetic (lineage-level loss mapping)
note: Sporulation-loss in gut Firmicutes; no continuous environmental-variability predictor.

design: comparative conservation analysis; phylogenetic yes (concatenated sporulation + ribosomal protein trees)
note: Defines conserved ~60-gene sporulation core; documents loss in Erysipelotrichaceae/Planococcaceae. No environment axis.

design: categorical lifestyle/habitat residual-after-genome-size; phylogenetic no
note: Baseline type-II TA survey. "Aquatic" (fresh+marine pooled) enriched in TA as a residual - points OPPOSITE to this study's marine deficit.

design: categorical (open-ocean/coastal/freshwater); TA ~ genome size (linear); phylogenetic no
note: 0/38 Prochlorococcus carry TA; 27/33 Synechococcus do. Clade-level support for open-ocean TA depletion.

design: continuous growth-rate estimation; cultured vs uncultured comparison; phylogenetic partial (codon-based)
note: Key culturing-bias evidence: culture collections strongly biased toward fast growers. Underpins collider-bias concern for the isolate slope.

n_species_or_taxa: 1573 species with Balon (23/27 phyla); 603 species (38%) multi-copy
design: presence/multi-copy homology survey across representative bacteria; phylogenetic (tree mapping) but NO temperature/habitat test
note: Discovery in cold Psychrobacter; reports Balon in ~20% of species and 2-4 copies in 38%. The cold/temperature association is inferred from one organism, NOT tested across genomes.

n_species_or_taxa: global soil metagenomes (Bahram/Bary dataset; see Bahram 2018: 189 sites)
design: continuous (soil pH, C:N, precipitation) community genomic traits (C-R-S); phylogenetic partial (PGLS sensitivity)
note: Community-weighted genome-size/trait analysis; smaller genomes under seasonal/arid soils. Community-level, not per-genome.

design: species-level niche breadth (habitat clusters, not site); phylogenetic yes (MCMCglmm + PGLS, 50% subsampling)
note: Closest methodological template. Handles non-independence at habitat-cluster level, NOT site-level - so avoids this study's per-site pseudoreplication problem.

study: Madin et al. 2020 Sci Data (trait database)
design: trait-data synthesis of 26 sources; spans all habitats; phylogenetic (resource for PGLS)
note: The standard prokaryote trait-environment resource; basis for Westoby 2021.

n_genomes: 26101 representative genomes (MAGs from GEM/stratfreshDB + GTDB isolates)
design: categorical ecosystem type vs genome size; MAG-vs-isolate ANI comparison; phylogenetic partial
note: GTDB-scale genome-size vs ecosystem. Finds MAGs only ~3.7% smaller than co-clustered isolates - relevant to whether MAG/isolate differences are artifactual.

design: trait-trait correlation (cell size, genome size, growth rate); phylogenetic yes (PGLS/phylolm v2.6.1 on GTDB tree)
note: Uses same phylolm approach as this study; excludes MAG-only species (traits unknown) - illustrates the isolate-only convention this study departs from.

design: niche-breadth classification; phylogenetic (evolutionary reconstruction)
note: Per-taxon niche summaries across many samples avoid per-genome site pseudoreplication by design.

study: von Meijenfeldt et al. 2023 Nat Ecol Evol
n_species_or_taxa: genus-level social niche breadth across tree of life
design: continuous social-niche-breadth; phylogenetic yes
note: Same design logic (per-taxon summary across samples); no site-level predictor.

design: continuous environment vs community gene composition; phylogenetic no
note: Underlying dataset scale for Piton 2023. Community-level.

study: Hu et al. 2022 BMC Genomics (GC vs Topt)
design: continuous (optimal growth temperature); phylogenetic yes (PGLS)
note: GTDB-scale-adjacent trait-environment PGLS; shows small-n (155 archaea) can flip significance - a power cautionary tale.

design: categorical habitat; defense-system (incl. TA-like) counts; genome-size correlation; phylogenetic partial
note: ~65% of marine MAGs have a "limited defensome"; flags MAG under-recovery of MGE-borne defenses as bias. Marine-deficit support but MAG-based.

design: defense-system content vs genome size/viral threat/lifestyle; phylogenetic no
note: Isolate-genome (complete) baseline for defense-system variation; no marine-vs-terrestrial contrast.

design: temperature-class comparison; phylogenetic no
note: Toxins depleted at hot AND cold temperature extremes - a temperature confounder for the marine (cold SST) TA deficit. No marine-vs-terrestrial test.

study: Meaden, Westra & Fineran 2025 Phil Trans R Soc B
design: continuous (viral density); defense abundance by environment; phylogenetic no
note: Binning-INDEPENDENT evidence that marine environments are depleted in defense systems - the strongest non-artifact support for a real marine deficit.
